title: Render runner counts instead of unavailable badges in pickers
goal:
Render runner counts instead of unavailable badges in pickers
Source: docs/tasks/b3401f19-2897-4049-aa3c-227bcee46a4c/RESPONSE.md WP-D (WIDE_NET cause 4, N6), RESPONSE_SURVEY.md q9/q10/q13 + round-2 q19/q20, TESTING_GUIDE.md section 4, REPLICATION_GUIDE.md section 4. Parent bug: task b3401f19.

Evidence: ModelSelector.jsx:318-342 lets fleetSnapshotBadgeNode (the "Unavailable" verdict) win over fleetCountBadgeNode; the harness row ("Muse Code UNAVAILABLE") comes from the backend container's local CLI probe (harnessAvailabilityBadgeNode -> backend harnessDiscovery; ModelSelector.jsx:33-44) -- the backend container (pid 256006, cwd /app) has no muse binary even though runners serve Muse. modelStatus.js fleetSnapshotBadge/fleetCountBadgeNode dual contract; fleetModelsForHarness synthesizes entries without re-validating harness section.

Files owned (sole owner): frontend/src/components/common/ModelSelector.jsx, frontend/src/services/modelStatus.js, frontend/src/services/fleetModelOptions/fleetModelsForHarness.js, frontend/src/components/settings/ModelAliasesSection.jsx, Settings fleet-catalogue/admin view, and their tests. Build against the WP-C response contract in RESPONSE.md section 4 (models[] with runnerCount/declaredBy/verified/available-derived, harnesses[] counts, quarantined[]) using fixtures until WP-C merges.

Change: (1) Model rows ALWAYS render fleetCountBadgeNode: "N runners" green/neutral, "0 runners" grey; remove fleetSnapshotBadgeNode from picker rows (ModelSelector.jsx:318-342, ModelAliasesSection.jsx); verified:false && declaredBy.length adds subtle "unverified" annotation (tooltip "declared by local-alpha, not found by its discovery"); unverified and 0-runner rows stay selectable. (2) fleetModelsForHarness: delete provider and bare branches; only harness-form ids with parsed.harness===hid render (defence in depth). (3) Harness dropdown badge = fleet harness count from catalogue.harnesses ("2 runners"/grey "0 runners"); backend-local probe badge + install hint move to System Settings -> Backend harnesses only. (4) Settings (admin): fleet-catalogue table (runnerCount, verified, declaredBy, lastServedAt/age, per-runner discovery status incl. WP-B NOT_YET_RUN/LEG_MODULE_MISSING/stale), "Remove permanently" button (WP-C DELETE), quarantine list with remove, "Re-scan" button via existing requestModelRediscovery. (5) Stored references to absent/0-runner ids render "not currently served"; never auto-clear.

Survey constraints: q9 always show counts incl. grey "0 runners"; q10 health details in Settings/admin; q13 keep references marked "not currently served"; q19 runner counts drive badges; q20 unverified selectable but clearly marked.

Acceptance: entry {available:false,runnerCount:0} renders "0 runners" ("Unavailable" today); fleetModelsForHarness('muse',{'ollama-cloud-direct::gemma4:31b-cloud':{harnesses:['muse','pi']}}) returns 0 entries (1 today); muse option with catalogue.harnesses=[{id:'muse',runnerCount:1}] + backend available:false renders "1 runner" ("Unavailable" today); fixtures follow WP-C contract; after WP-C merges, one integration test runs against real createFleetModelSnapshotStore({filePath:null}) output. Sequencing: BLOCKED BY WP-C (merge after WP-C); may be built in parallel against the contract fixtures.
